Geographies Served Programs Shelter for Underprivileged Children. District Washim Parbhani Jalna District Washim Parbhani Jalna We provide shelter to the children of drought-affected farmers who do suicide. Snehwan through this program is providing shelter to these children. Impact Metrics Increasing Residential Support for Boys Year-wise Metrics 2019-20 30 2020-21 50 2021-22 50 Theory of Change 1- We believe that, Be the change that you want to see in the world. We believe on eco-friendly living and zero carbon waste, hence We start generating our own electricity by solar. We also generate our kitchen gas by cow dung. 2- We accepted changes in education system, we believes in practicle education. Hence we built science lab, electronic lab, music centre, art gallery and agri enterprenuer centre in Snehwan for children. 3- We never watch TV in Snehwan, we started 3 types of libraries in Snehwan. Every children needs to read book for 2 hrs daily. 4- We believe on equality so we have common community kichen in Snehwan. We eat together, we grow together. 5- We are starting Open school in next few days, where children can choose their favorite subject to learn. --> Milestones & Track Record Snehwan was looking to increase the size of their family by bringing in more and more children to their little haven near Pune. But they wanted to expand and were looking for an affordable land nearby. Having seen the same poverty as these children, he wanted them to learn more and most of all, become better human beings. In 2018, Dr. Smita Kulkarni and Dr. Ravindra Kulkarni donated two acres of land to Snehwan. Late Nalini Kulkarni Dnyangram project was started on this land. There was only one aim – caring and educating needy farmers’ children with an emphasis on their holistic development.
